summary: Staff claims, private data rules and transactional checkout are live. On 2026-10-27, Enterprise App Check was registered, required on all four application APIs and configured as Enforced for Cloud Firestore. Missing-token API tests and genuine-browser tracking/checkout checks pass. This is a scoped review, not a guarantee against every security issue.

findings.issue: Application APIs require App Check and Cloud Firestore is configured as Enforced. Firebase Authentication remains in Monitoring; direct authentication operations are not yet protected by service-level App Check enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Monitor verified authentication traffic and verify a fresh staff email/password login before separately enforcing App Check for Authentication. Monitor the no-cost assessment allowance; no paid billing has been activated.
